text:
Priya Shah: Quick thought — proposing a compact incident follow-up timeline and comms cadence we can pilot next quarter. 24h owner ack, 7d remediation PR, 30d validation/pattern check. Thoughts?
Luca Marin: I like the rhythm. Can we explicitly include a 30d pattern review to catch recurring flakes?
Aisha Khan: +1 to 30d. Also think we should formalize an IC rotation cadence (6 weeks?) so ownership doesn’t concentrate.
Zach B: Agree, but question: where do we track actions? current spreadsheet is messy.
Priya Shah: Proposal: central Jira board (label: postmortem-action) with statuses: triaged / in-progress / PR-ready / validated. Automations create reminders at 7 and 30 days.
Luca Marin: Jira gives SLAs and reminders. If we keep tickets short (one action per ticket) it’ll be easier to audit.
Aisha Khan: I worry about Jira overhead — maybe a minimal board + a Notion view for non-IC stakeholders.
OncallBot: [automated] Reminder: Incident 2031451234 follow-up due in 7 days — owner: Priya Shah.
Priya Shah: Draft timeline (for pilot):
```
Day 0: Incident declared, IC assigned, initial channel notes
Day 1 (24h): Postmortem skeleton + assign remediation owners
Day 7: Remediation PRs opened or documented mitigations
Day 30: Validation run + pattern analysis for similar incidents
Day 60: Closure, final retro notes, update runbooks if needed
```
Luca Marin: For comms cadence: short Slack thread updates at T+1 and T+7, consolidated email to stakeholders at T+7 for severity >= P2, and a T+30 note in #incidents summarizing validation.
Zach B: Suggest adding a 'risk tier' field on tickets so high-risk ones get daily T+1..T+7 updates.
Aisha Khan: Rotation mechanics: 6-week IC rotation, include a one-day overlap for handoff and a handoff template (what to check, open actions).
Priya Shah: For tracking recurring patterns: add a 'pattern-flag' label and a lightweight query in logs/dashboards that the 30d reviewer runs.
Luca Marin: I'll own the Jira board for the Q2 pilot and configure the automations.
Zach B: I'll add the label + automation to create reminders and wire a small GH Action to ping the board on deploy regressions.
Aisha Khan: I'll draft the IC handoff template in /docs/incidents/ic-handoff.md and link it from the postmortem skeleton.
Priya Shah: Sounds good — volunteers: Luca (board), Zach (automation), Aisha (handoff doc), Priya (postmortem template + pilot checklist).
Luca Marin: SGTM. :thumbsup:
Zach B: One more ask — can we add an alert for 'similar error signature' detection to surface during the 30d pattern review? saves manual hunting.
Aisha Khan: Good call. I’ll add a query to the logs dashboard and include it in the validation checklist.
Priya Shah: Perfect. I’ll update the postmortem template to include fields: owner, due dates, risk tier, pattern-flag, and follow-up ticket IDs. I’ll create the pilot checklist and post it here by EOD. :rocket:
Luca Marin: Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.
